blurb: This check grades Shared Storage Pool alert thresholds on a VIOS and is separate from ssp_cluster. No cluster is not applicable. After the cluster is present it runs alert -list. PASS only when every ThresholdPercent is an integer from 1 to 99. 35 is the documented default, not the only legal value. No ThresholdPercent line warns. 0, 100, and N/A are not assessed. alert -set is not run.
